main_text.p: 2. Reg. 11.13. & 23.3. Quomodo convenit סטיו. ܐܣܛܘܝܣ Syr. Stoici, Στωϊκοί, Act.17.18.
ܐܣܛܘܟܣܝܐ Syr. Elementa, Elementares institutiones, rudimenta, ad Gal.4.3.9. & ad Col.2.8.20. Corruptum ex Graeco στοιχεῖον, στοιχεία.
אִסְטְלָיתָא, אִסְטוֹלָא, אִסְטַלָּא Ch. ܣܛܘܠܐ Syr. Στολή, Stola, pallium. Scribitur etiam quandoque אצטלא per ץ.
ܣܛܘܡܐܟܘܣ Syr. Stomachus, Στόμαχος, 1. ad Tim. 5.24.
ܣܛܣܝܣ Syr. Seditio, Graec. στάσις, Lucae 23.19.25. Sed Marci 15.7. legitur ܣܛܣܝܢ ad formam accusativi Graec. στάσιν. Talmudici dicunt אסטסית.
אסטרא, אסטרטא Chald. Via, Semita, Strata. Plural. אסטרטין, אסטרטיא. Vide & אסרט.
ܣܛܪܛܝܣ Syr. Miles, Graece Στρατιώτης. Plural.

אסטרטיג, ܣܛܪܛܝܓܘܣ Ch.& Syr. Dux, Praefectus exercitus, Imperator, Capitaneus: Item Statio militum, Acies stationaria, Milites stationarii, Hebr. נציב: Plural. אסטרטיגין & אסטרטגין, Syr. ܣܛܪܛܝܓܘܣ: & quandoque etiam absque ܣܛܪܛܝܓ.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew/Greek forms are rendered from the scan as far as legible; the Syriac and Greek script in several entries is partly illegible in the scan and may not be exact. "Praefectus" is printed "Præfectus" with a long-s-like ligature; "Pręfectus" as printed.
